newsitem.title: USA: Cyclone Harold continues to threaten shipping.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone Harold continues to threaten shipping.

text.p: Tropical Cyclone Harold, with 65 mph winds, is in the Coral Sea, east of Queensland, Australia, near 17.3s/155.0e, moving south-southwest at 8 mph, forecaster Weather Services Corp said.
Harold is expected to turn more southerly and eventually more southeasterly away from mainland Australia over the next 48-72 hours while slowly strengthening.
The threat to shipping from this system will continue.
